fields.Name: KPI Gauge Dashboard with 4-Level Drill-Down
fields.Description: Skip analytics conversation from the More Cheese suite

fields.Message: Design a comprehensive KPI dashboard for our association with six radial gauge charts arranged in a 2x3 grid. The gauges should show: (1) Membership Retention Rate as a percentage with a target of 85%, (2) Event Attendance Rate (registered vs attended) targeting 70%, (3) Course Completion Rate targeting 65%, (4) Average Revenue Per Member targeting $500, (5) Overall Engagement Score (0-100) targeting 75, and (6) Member Satisfaction Score targeting 4.5 out of 5. Color each gauge based on performance: green if meeting or exceeding target, yellow if within 10% of target, red if below that. When I click on any gauge, show me a line chart displaying that KPI's trend over the past 12 months so I can see how it's changed over time. Then, when I click on any data point in that trend line, show me another chart breaking down the contributing factors for that specific month - for example, if I clicked the retention gauge and then clicked on a month, show me a breakdown of why members left (expired, cancelled, etc.) as a pie chart. Finally, when I click on any segment of that breakdown chart, show me a detailed table of the actual members or transactions that make up that segment, with all relevant details. Ensure every row in that final table is clickable to open the appropriate record (member, event, course, etc.). Include clear labels on all gauges showing both the current value and the target, and make sure the dashboard has a clean layout with proper spacing. [NO CHAT]
I encountered difficulty creating the multi-metric queries for your dashboard, especially around aggregating all six distinct KPIs and calculating engagement and satisfaction scores.
